howItWorks.heading: Sannan binciken yana farawa.
howItWorks.lead: Kuma yanzu, maimakon farawa daga farko, kowa ya san inda aikin yake.
howItWorks.subtitle: Tsarin aikin binciken yana tafiya cikin haske da tsari — yana haɗa alkawura, buƙatu, ayyukan da aka raba, takardu, bita, shawara, da kammalawa a cikin sarkar da ba ta katsewa.

howItWorks.step2Desc: Mai bincike yana fitar da buƙatun takardu tare da lokutan ƙarshe da rukunoni daki-daki.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Ana damƙa buƙatu kai tsaye ga mambobin ƙungiyar lissafin kuɗi masu alhakin aikin.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Mambobin ƙungiyar lissafin kuɗi suna loda takaddun shaida kai tsaye ga kowace buƙata.
howItWorks.step5Desc: Mai bincike yana duba shaidun a cikin keɓantaccen ɗakin bita.
howItWorks.step6Desc: Mai bincike yana amincewa da shaida ko ƙin karɓa tare da rubutaccen dalili mai bayyane.
howItWorks.step7Desc: Aikin bincike ya cika dukkan buƙatu kuma an adana tarihin binciken har abada.

storyProblem.heading: Binciken kuɗi ba ya farawa kawai lokacin da mai bincike ya iso.
storyProblem.subtitle: Kyakkyawan shiri yana farawa ne kafin babban bincike ya zo. Ƙungiyoyin akantoci suna kula da jerin binciken ƙarshen wata, daidaita lissafi, takardun doka, takardun shaida, da amincewa. FinAuditEase yana tattara duka a wuri ɗaya cikin tsari.
storyProblem.step1Desc: Shigar da bayanan kuɗi da daidaita asusun kowane wata a kan lokaci.
storyProblem.step2Desc: Tattara takardun haraji da bayanan doka a kowane lokaci ba tare da tsaiko ba.
storyProblem.step3Desc: Fara jerin shirye-shiryen bincike watanni shida kafin ƙarshen shekarar lissafi.
storyProblem.step4Desc: Shiga aikin bincike tare da dukkan takardun shaida da aka tsara a wuri ɗaya.
storyProblem.bridgeText: Haɗa gibi tsakanin ƙididdigar kamfani da aikin binciken kuɗi na waje.

communication.privateIsolationNotice: Tattaunawar sirri an keɓe ta ga kai da wanda ka zaɓa kaɗai. Saƙonni da fayilolin da aka haɗa ba sa bayyana ga sauran membobin ƙungiyar gabaɗaya.

communication.startPrivateDesc: Fara tattaunawar sirri ta kai-tsaye tare da mai binciken kuɗi ko mamban Ƙungiyar Ƙididdigar Kuɗi.
communication.retentionPolicyNotice: Sanarwar Riƙe Hujjoji: A ƙarƙashin ƙa'idodin binciken kuɗi, saƙonni, tarurruka, da hujjoji dole ne a adana su dindindin. Masu amfani na yau da kullum ba za su iya goge tsoffin saƙonni ba.
communication.selectToStartDesc: Zaɓi tashar ƙungiyar bincike ko tattaunawar sirri mai izini daga gefe don duba tarihin sadarwa da shiga tarurrukan bincike.
communication.evidenceRetentionDescription: Duk sadarwa, bayanan tarurruka, da takardun da aka loda wani ɓangare ne na takardun aikin bincike na doka. An haramta goge su gaba ɗaya ko yin gyare-gyare a kansu.
communication.backendPendingTitle: Ƙofar Aika Saƙonni Tana Jiran Ƙaddamarwa
communication.backendPendingDesc: Injiniyoyi ba su riga sun ƙaddamar da aikin sadarwa na gefen uwar garke ba. Dangane da ƙa'idodin amincin binciken kuɗi, ba ma ƙirƙirar saƙonnin bogi. Ainihin saƙonni za su bayyana da zarar an ƙaddamar da sabis ɗin.

communication.mandatoryConsentNoticeTitle: Tabbatar da Yarda da Dokar Mahalarta
communication.mandatoryConsentNoticeText: Duk mahalartan da aka gayyata dole ne su ba da tabbatacciyar yarda kafin a fara ɗaukar sauti/bidiyo. Idan wani ya ƙi, ba za a iya ci gaba da taron a yanayin ɗaukar hoto/sauti ba a ƙarƙashin dokokin bincike.
communication.noMembersToInvite: Babu mambobin da za a gayyata.

communication.valParticipantsRequired: Dole ne a gayyaci aƙalla mutum ɗaya.
communication.valEngagementRequired: Dole ne a zaɓi aikin bincike mai aiki.
communication.schedulingEndpointPending: Wurin tsara tarurruka POST /api/v1/communication/meetings yana jiran ƙaddamarwa. Ba za a iya aika gayyata ta gaske ba har sai an kammala aikin uwar garke.
communication.recordingActiveAria: Ana ɗaukar wannan taron a matsayin hujjar bincike
communication.consentGateDescription: An ayyana wannan taron bincike a matsayin wajibi a ɗauki sauti/bidiyonsa a ƙarƙashin ƙa'idodin tabbatar da doka. Za a ɗauki sauti, bidiyo, da nunin allon kwamfuta, a sarrafa su, kuma a adana su dindindin a ma'ajiyar hujjoji.
communication.consentStatutoryNotice: Yarda da doka ta zama wajibi kafin a iya fara ɗaukar sauti ko bidiyo.
communication.grantRecordingConsent: Bayar da Izinin Ɗaukar Sauti & Hujja
communication.consentDeclinedTitle: An Ƙi Ba da Izinin Ɗaukar Sauti/Bidiyo
communication.consentDeclinedPolicyText: Kun ƙi ba da izinin ɗaukar sauti/bidiyo. A ƙarƙashin ƙa'idodin FinAuditEase, tarurrukan da ke buƙatar ɗaukar sauti ba za su iya ci gaba ba ba tare da yardar dukkan mahalarta ba.
communication.declinedPolicyRule1: Taron da ake ɗauka ba zai iya farawa ba matuƙar aka ƙi ba da izini.
communication.declinedPolicyRule2: Masu binciken kuɗi ba za su iya yin aiki ba ba tare da takardun hujja da aka amince da su ba.
communication.declinedPolicyRule3: Da fatan za a tuntuɓi Babban Mai Binciken Kuɗi don sake tsara lokaci ko tattauna wasu hanyoyin tabbatarwa.
communication.providerAwaitingDeploymentTitle: Tsarin Sabis na Bidiyo Yana Jiran Ƙaddamarwa
communication.providerAwaitingDeploymentDesc: Taron bidiyo a cikin manhaja yana buƙatar haɗin sabis na uwar garke da aka amince da shi (kamar WebRTC SFU na masana'antu ko amintacciyar ƙofar OAuth). An haramta hanyoyin haɗin da ba su da aminci don hujjojin bincike na sirri.
communication.recordingPipeline: Tsarin Ɗaukar Sauti na Uwar Garke
communication.serverPipelinePending: Ana Jiran Sabis na Uwar Garke
communication.defaultProviderNotes: FinAuditEase ya haramta hanyoyin bidiyo marasa aminci ko hanyoyin da ke nuna bayanan bincike na sirri a shafukan yanar gizo. Bidiyo zai fara aiki da kansa da zarar an tabbatar da ƙaddamar da ƙofar uwar garke.
communication.recordingEvidenceTitle: Tabbatar da Hujja & Dokar Rashin Gogewa
communication.recordingEvidenceDescription: Faifan bidiyon taro da aka amince da su hujjoji ne na dindindin da ake adanawa a ƙarƙashin ƙa'idodin rahoton kuɗi na shekaru 7. Masu amfani na yau da kullum da masu gudanarwa ba za su iya gogewa ko canza su ba.
communication.searchRecordingsPlaceholder: Nemi faifai ta suna, bincike, ko lambar tabbatarwa...
communication.noRecordingsTitle: Babu Faifan Hujja da Aka Kawo
communication.noRecordingsDescription: Babu wani faifai da sabis na uwar garke ya kawo don wannan aikin bincike. Faifan da aka amince da su za su bayyana a nan da zarar an kammala sarrafa su a uwar garke, an duba SHA-256, kuma an yi rajistar shiga.

communication.transcriptGenerating: Ana jiran sabis na maida sauti zuwa rubutu.
